content:
tara: FYI scheduling a small-window rolling reboot + NIC micro-firmware in us-central1-b tonight 02:00-02:40 UTC. Target: ai-infer-pool (120 GPUs), aux-train (24 GPUs). Goal: keep usable capacity >= 88% and avoid API error spikes. :alarm_clock:

sam: ack. what's cohort sizing and stagger?
evan: cohorts of 6 nodes, 8m between cohorts. 2-node canary first. KV and prefix caches will be reseeded after each cohort.

tara: runbook snippet for ops:
```
# drain cohort
python infra/ops/drain.py --region us-central1 --cohort 6 --pools ai-infer-pool,aux-train --dry-run false
# postcheck
./tools/kvcache_check.sh --region us-central1 --pool ai-infer-pool || exit 1
```

chun: preflight on staging looks clean. NIC drop count zero, max p95 delta 30ms. s/b safe. sre-bot: preflight result posted.

sre-bot: [preflight] staging-nic-fw-roll: success=98.7%, max_p95_delta=31ms, regressions=0

oncall: I'll monitor logs and run smoke after each cohort: `./scripts/smoke.sh --pool ai-infer-pool` and ping status endpoint.

finance-bot: estimate: if we backfill to on-demand for 30m might add ~$900. Tagging cost center infra-maint-1766677777.
sam: backfill policy? are we allowing burst to 140%? that's higher than normal.
tara: allow short burst to 125% for first 10m, then ramp down to 105% over next 20m. No >125% sustained. We'll set an autoscaler cap override for maintenance.

chun: note about warmup: some large models lose batching efficiency after kernel restart. We'll persist scheduler flags and run a warmup job for top 3 models immediately after each cohort.
evan: add small warmup load: `k8s run warmup-onnx --replicas 2 --env MODELS=MODEL_A,MODEL_B`

oncall: escalation criteria: pause if (a) >2 nodes with NIC flaps in a cohort OR (b) p95 increase >250ms on infer endpoints OR (c) error rate >1.5%. If paused we'll rollback last cohort and file hw-ticket.

sam: reminder: don't run PCIe resets without hw team signoff. we've had flaky results in az3.

chun: I'll post a customer-facing blurb to status.redwood.ai and notify support. tara can you add the maintenance tag to billing and owner?
tara: done. tag=maintenance:1766677777 owner=tara

oncall: will paste cohort-by-cohort smoke outputs here during the window.
tara: thanks team. starting at 02:00 UTC. I'll provide live updates here. :thumbsup:
